## Source

Name and public URL/API documentation:

## What does this source measure?

Describe the entities, metrics, or evidence available.

## Relevant TopTenUG categories

Which universes/rankings could use this source?

## Access method

- [ ] Official API
- [ ] Public dataset
- [ ] RSS/feed
- [ ] Public web pages
- [ ] Search/grounded research
- [ ] Other

## Coverage

Describe Uganda coverage, geographic scope, identity information, and known gaps.

## Freshness

How often is the source updated, and how often should TopTenUG ingest it?

## Cost / rate limits

Document known quotas, pricing, authentication, or rate limits.

## Terms / licensing / ethical considerations

Note relevant access rules, licensing, attribution, scraping restrictions, or privacy concerns.

## Proposed fields / observations

List the raw fields or metrics we should retain.

## Reliability and known biases

Explain why this source is useful and what it may systematically miss or overrepresent.

## Example records

Provide a few public examples if useful.
